transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this final-rundown meeting started. We've got the opening segment to lock down — 90 seconds before the first presenter appears. The current draft has the lift-based stage entrance, 'Neon Hearts,' and Maya Chen as sole host. Before I make my binding approval, I need each of you — choreography, music, and talent operations — to report any item that must be reflected before we lock the rundown. Who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical safety issue before we lock anything. My post-rehearsal load check found that the planned lift entrance would place 950 pounds on a stage point certified for only 800 pounds — that's an overload. The floor-based choreography alternative is approved for 12 dancers and would avoid this issue entirely. I'm still waiting for the venue engineer's written report before sending it to the production office, but this must be reflected before we lock the rundown.
